On January 9, 2026, we acquired 100% of Worldpay Holdco, LLC from Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. and affiliates of GTCR LLC
On November 14, 2025, we issued $6.2 billion aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes in connection with the acquisition of Worldpay
